payload.text: Akaal Organics Pharmaceuticals & Innovative Fine Chemicals Organic Fine Chemicals Research, Development and Custom Manufacturing We specialize in custom manufacturing of high purity fine chemicals for use in Life Sciences , Chemistry , Diagnostics research and industry. Our products include Peptides, Fmoc and BOC Amino Acid Derivatives, Unnatural Amino Acids, Lipids, Phospholipids, Sphingolipids, Carbohydrates, Diagnostic Dyes, Click on the individual links to learn more and browse our stock of products and services. Learn More Find what you need We specialize in a broad range of products and diagnostic tools. If you cannot find what you need in our shop, contact us! We have over twenty years of experience manufacturing custom solutions to your business needs. Shop Now [/about] About | Explore High-Quality Chemicals Today — Akaal Organics About | Explore High-Quality Chemicals Today — Akaal Organics Pharmaceuticals & Innovative Fine Chemicals We deliver pharmaceutical, diagnostic and research-grade products of the highest quality and purity. We have over 30 years of experience in organic fine chemical synthesis and we continue to provide extensive personalized customer service. Our main products include custom-manufactured peptides, enzyme inhibitors and substrates, glycopeptides, carbohydrates, glycolipids, phospholipids, sphingolipids, resins and unnatural amino acid derivatives. We also offer diagnostic dyes, fluorescent dyes, for labelling of carbohydrates (glycans), and applications in DNA and RNA sequencing. We are constantly developing and improving production methods that reduce the use of toxic chemicals, the amount of toxic waste, and limit the use of water and energy. We strive to lower the overall impact of our operation on the environment and the local community, while keeping pricing competitive. Akaal Organics is headed by Narinder Paul Singh, Ph.D., who has extensive experience in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) and custom organic synthesis of pharmaceutical grade as well as research grade fine chemicals, and Christina Roetzel, a biologist with experience in medical, microbiological, and physiological research. We speak English, French, German, Punjabi and Hindi.
